title: Fix missing photo and non-working music on landing page

requirements.text: Fix the landing page photo so the user’s photo reliably displays in production, rather than failing to load from the current Google Photos share URL (https://photos.app.goo.gl/UswyaKrbtbzie7AQ8). Use a local static photo asset as the primary source when present, and keep a graceful fallback to the existing placeholder image (/assets/generated/photo-placeholder.dim_1024x1024.png) if the local photo is missing or fails to load.

quotes: Music is not working and were is my photo

acceptanceCriteria: When the app is deployed, the photo renders without requiring access to Google Photos share pages.
If the local photo asset is missing or cannot be loaded, the UI shows /assets/generated/photo-placeholder.dim_1024x1024.png without breaking layout.
The Google Photos URL is not the only/primary way the photo is displayed (it may be retained only as an optional backup if needed).

requirements.text: Fix the landing page music player so the track loads and plays reliably in production using the local static audio file path currently referenced by the app (/assets/20-dollears-in-my-pocket.mp3). Add user-visible error handling so that if the audio file cannot be fetched/decoded, the UI clearly indicates the track failed to load and suggests refreshing or checking the asset path.

quotes: Music is not working and were is my photo

acceptanceCriteria: The audio player successfully plays the track in a deployed build (not only locally).
If /assets/20-dollears-in-my-pocket.mp3 is missing or fails to load, the page shows an English error message near the player (and does not silently fail).
The track label text remains exactly: "20 dollears in my pocket".

requirements.text: Ensure all required static media assets are present in the frontend build output under the public static assets path so that the deployed site can fetch them via absolute URLs: (1) the user photo asset and (2) the MP3 file.

quotes: Music is not working and were is my photo

acceptanceCriteria: A square portrait photo asset exists at a stable public path and is the one used by the landing page photo component.
The MP3 file is present at /assets/20-dollears-in-my-pocket.mp3 in the deployed build output and returns a successful HTTP response when requested.
No backend changes are required for serving the photo/audio.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Keep all backend logic in the existing single Motoko actor (backend/main.mo); no new backend canisters/services.
nonGoals: Adding new authentication methods beyond Internet Identity.
Adding streaming, playlists, or a full music library.
Building an admin upload system for photos/audio (static assets only for this fix).
